entities.summary: Abinsk is a town and the administrative center of Abinsky District of Krasnodar Krai, Russia, located 75 kilometers (47 mi) southwest of Krasnodar, the administrative center of the krai. Population: 39,058 (2020), 34,928 (2010 census); 33,734 (2002 census); 29,182 (1989 Soviet census); 23,000 (1968).
